pinned.digest_source: the digest GitHub records for the release asset (release API digest field), read 2026-11-18

output_file_recorded_as: the bundle relative path of frames.csv; the process received the absolute path of that file in this bundle, in double quotes
observes: ETW trace session consumed by PresentMon (vendor README: the PresentData library performs the lowest-level collection and analysis of ETW events); capture by process name or for every process, never by process id; no overlay, no injection

option_citations.--session_name: Use the specified session name instead of the default "PresentMon".
option_citations.--output_file: Write CSV output to the specified path.
option_citations.--no_console_stats: Do not display active swap chains and frame statistics in the console.
option_citations.--qpc_time: Output the CPU start time as a performance counter value.
option_citations.--timed: Stop recording after the specified amount of time.
option_citations.--terminate_after_timed: When using --timed, terminate PresentMon after the timed capture completes.
option_citations.--process_name: Only record processes with the specified exe name. This argument can be repeated to capture multiple processes.
option_citations.--terminate_existing_session: If a trace session with the same name is already running, stop the existing session then exit.
